telegram.welcome:
Hello! Welcome to the “Ish topdim” bot.
Notifications about applications, offers and new messages will arrive here.
telegram.hint: Tap the button below to open the app.
telegram.login_code_warning: The code is valid for 5 minutes. Don't share it with anyone — “Ish topdim” staff will never ask for your code.
telegram.share_phone_prompt: Link your phone number so you can sign in on the website (in a browser) with it — login codes will arrive here instead of by SMS. Tap the button below 👇
telegram.phone_linked:
✅ Your number is linked: {phone}
Now when you enter this number on the website, the login code will arrive in this chat.
telegram.phone_already_linked:
Your number is linked: {phone}
Go back to the website and tap “Send code” — the code will arrive here.
telegram.phone_not_own: Please send only your own number using the button below.
telegram.phone_invalid: Couldn't read the number. Please try again.

listing.listing_expiring_body: Extend it so employers keep seeing you.
listing.listing_expired_body: You're no longer visible in search. Tap to extend.

match.worker_title: We found a new job that matches you!
match.worker_title_many: We found {count} jobs that match you!
match.employer_title: We found a matching candidate for your vacancy!
match.employer_title_many: We found {count} matching candidates for your vacancy!

moderation.active_body: «{title}» passed the review and is now public.
moderation.rejected_body: Ish topdim accepts only job and job-seeker listings. Please change the unrelated or prohibited part of your text.
moderation.review_body: A moderator will review «{title}». We will let you know the result.
moderation.verification_body: «{title}» will go public once you are verified as an employer.
moderation.employer_verified_body: Your waiting vacancies are now public.

telegram.link_ok: ✅ Your Telegram is now linked to «Ish topdim».

telegram.link_expired: This link has expired. Get a new one in the app.
telegram.link_invalid: The link is invalid. Please try again from the app.
telegram.link_elsewhere: This Telegram is linked to another account. Sign in with that account or contact support.

telegram.subscribed_employer: 🔔 Notifications are on: we will message you here when a matching candidate appears.
